# Tank Duel

A three.js tank duel against the computer. The page `/index.html` declares WebMCP tools
(`document.modelContext.registerTool`); use them instead of the buttons and keys.

- `describe`: reads the game state (arena, walls, tanks, shells, score, round, state, paused, ai).
- `pause`: pauses or resumes real-time play.
- `step`: while paused, advances the game by some seconds in 1/60 s steps.
- `place`: moves a tank to a free spot in the arena.
- `fire`: fires a shell from a tank, as Space does.
- `set_ai`: switches the computer's driving and firing on or off.
- `reset`: starts a new game.
